title: Frosted Banking Dashboard on Blue Velvet
whatItIs: A laptop tilted on a ribbed blue velvet cushion against a pale blue wall, showing a frosted banking dashboard with balance, quick actions, transactions, upcoming bills, an earning chart, send money form and a credit card, with a mouse cursor nearby.
whatItMeans: The blue velvet matches the UI's blue and adds tactile richness, and frosted cards keep the data calm.
techniques: Ribbed velvet as a stage matched to the palette
Frosted white cards over a blue-grey wash
Laptop cropped by the frame edge

vocabulary.definition: A set whose colour matches the interface.
A pointer graphic added to imply interaction.
